lines.en: will be held in our country in four years' time.
lines.zh: 4年以后，奥林匹克运动会将在我们国家举行。

lines.en: As a great many people will be visiting the country, the government will be building new hotels, an immense stadium , and a new Olympic- standard swimming pool.
lines.zh: 由于将有大批的人到我们国家来，所以政府准备建造一些新的饭店、一个大型体育场和一个新的奥运会标准游泳池。

lines.en: They will also be building new roads and a special railway line.
lines.zh: 他们还将修筑一些新的道路和一条铁路专线。

lines.en: The Games will be held just outside the capital and the whole area will be called 'Olympic City'.
lines.zh: 奥运会就在首都市郊举办，整个地区将被称作“奥林匹克城”。

lines.en: Workers will have completed the new roads by the end of this year.
lines.zh: 工人们将在今年年底前把新路铺好；到明年年底，他们将把新体育场建成。

lines.en: By the end of next year, they will have finished work on the new stadium.
lines.zh: 这些巨大的现代化建筑是由库尔特。

lines.en: The fantastic modern buildings have been designed by Kurt Gunter.
Everybody will be watching anxiously as the new buildings go up.
lines.zh: 大家都将急切地注视着新建筑的建成。

lines.en: We are all very excited and are looking forward to the Olympic Games because they have never been held before in this country.
lines.zh: 我们都非常激动，盼望着奥运会的到来，因为在这个国家里还从未举办过奥运会。
